propositions: The tickets store contains 561 pre-existing fsck diagnostics (550 stale-channel, 10 orphan-event, 1 status-fork-resolved) that must be remediated while preserving intentional audit records.
All 10 orphan-event findings are LINK-type and AUTO-RECOVER-eligible across 9 mixed tickets; zero HUMAN-TRIAGE orphans exist.
The scoped stale-channel repair tool (Gerrit 1391) must refuse mutation of tickets with mixed faults (stale+orphan or stale+inconsistent) and support resumable batching via --limit.
Dry-run and live repair must be executed in order: AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair first, then stale-channel-only batches, with rollback bundle and exact pre-repair tip preserved before mutation.
Post-repair fsck must report zero repairable findings (zero stale-channel, zero orphan, zero inconsistent) while retaining exactly the four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records.

The disposable rehearsal revealed that rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log self-commits, breaking the batch driver's commit/push contract; the batching driver must be modified to defer all rebuild commits to its existing batch commit-and-push block.
